lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters distributed across the mid-lateral flank posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersecting horizontal spot series to form a grid-like pattern on the mid-section of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Prominent horizontal linear feature on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp luminance transition from high on the superior edge to shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense, high-contrast circular spot patterning on the dorsal surface and leading edge of the visible left pectoral fin.
